note: Per-build object-layout data for the in-WM payload. These are NOT patch sites: they are the WindowID / WindowIDTable class metadata (live isa values) and the two Swift stored-property offset globals the registry diagnostic reads. Every entry is keyed by CFBundleVersion|sha256(__TEXT) and is verified against the live process by wmhb --verify before any byte is written (the helper must find WindowID objects whose isa matches, and the WM's own WindowIDTable serials must agree with them). See CONTROL.md, 'known per-build fragility'.

layout.map_value: cgWindowID u32 @0, stageID u32 @4, owner String@8, title@0x18

evidence: widmeta 0x1005a3568: live isa of every WindowID object (round 30, 394 objects; round 31 verify: 125 objects / 117 table entries / 116 matched)
ivar_reg 0x1005b4640 / ivar_comp 0x1005b1e78: the two offset globals publish_rg reads; round 31 verify reads 0x4e0 / 0x42d0
